目的与范围

7.2 节覆盖 RoboFrame 的技能管理生态系统，横跨两个核心包：skill_catalog 与 skill_library。

  • skill_catalog：为技能包、实现与档案实现闭模式校验 src/skill_catalog/skill_catalog/validator.py。它提供清单、能力模式、档案（so101_single_arm.yaml、lekiwi_lidar.yaml、lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar.yaml）以及编译本地快照的编译逻辑 src/embodied_common/test/test_social_gestures.py。

  • skill_library：提供运行时辅助工具，将抽象技能、目标、命名位姿与方向到偏移量的变换解析为具体的 ROS 原语序列 src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py。

1. 技能清单与能力模式

RoboFrame 中的每个技能都由一个带版本的技能包定义，包含 manifest.yaml、描述变体、实现映射与能力契约。

清单结构与闭模式校验

清单通过 skill_catalog.validator 中的 validate_manifest 严格校验 src/skill_catalog/skill_catalog/validator.py，确保字段精确匹配（schema_version、name、version、semantic_level、description、capability、implementations）。

        graph TD
    A["Manifest File (manifest.yaml)"] --> B["validate_manifest()"]
    B --> C["Check Exact Fields"]
    C --> D["Validate Semantic Level (atomic_operator | skill)"]
    C --> E["Validate Capability Block (schema_version, domain, moves_robot, parameters)"]
    C --> F["Validate Implementations Map"]
    
    subgraph "Sources"
    B -.-> S1["src/skill_catalog/skill_catalog/validator.py"]
    end

来源：src/skill_catalog/skill_catalog/validator.py

以 resolve_object_pose 等导航能力为例，清单结构指定参数、恢复策略与所需控制模式 src/skill_catalog/config/skills/resolve_object_pose/manifest.yaml：

schema_version: 2
name: resolve_object_pose
version: 1.1.0
semantic_level: atomic_operator
description:
  summary: Query the semantic map for a named object and return its stand-off navigation target.
  category: navigation
capability:
  schema_version: 2
  summary: Query the semantic map and return a stand-off [x, y, yaw_degrees] target.
  domain: navigation
  moves_robot: false
  required_control_mode: base_navigation
  parameters:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      target_name:
        type: string
        enum: [banana, basket, paper ball, toy, ballpoint pen, grapes]
      stand_off_distance_m:
        type: number
        exclusiveMinimum: 0
        unit: meters
    required: [target_name]
  recovery_policy: ask_user
implementations:
  lekiwi_navigation_v2: implementations/lekiwi_navigation_v2.yaml

来源：src/skill_catalog/config/skills/resolve_object_pose/manifest.yaml

2. 技能档案与机器人关联

档案为特定机器人硬件配置定制一组启用的技能。它们将高层技能映射到机器人特定的实现包，并指定规划器可见性。

档案结构

档案位于 src/skill_catalog/config/profiles/ 下。例如 lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar.yaml 配置 act_cute、resolve_object_pose、close_gripper_skill 与 imitate_human_motion 等技能 src/skill_catalog/config/profiles/lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar.yaml：

schema_version: 1
name: lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar
robot_name: lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar
enabled_skills:
- name: act_cute
  implementation: so101_arm_v1
  planner_visible: true
- name: resolve_object_pose
  implementation: lekiwi_navigation_v2
  planner_visible: true
- name: imitate_human_motion
  implementation: lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar
  planner_visible: true

来源：src/skill_catalog/config/profiles/lekiwi_handeye_realsense_grasp_lidar.yaml, src/skill_catalog/config/profiles/lekiwi_lidar.yaml

3. 技能解析器与原语映射

skill_library.resolver 模块将高层请求与技能模板转换为有序的 PrimitiveSpec 执行 dataclass 列表 src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py。

PrimitiveSpec 与解析流程

        sequenceDiagram
    participant Agent as "Agent / Task Executor"
    participant Resolver as "resolve_skill_primitives() [resolver.py]"
    participant Templates as "get_skill_templates()"
    participant Primitive as "PrimitiveSpec"

    Agent->>Resolver: resolve_skill_primitives(skill_name, target_name, place_name, ...)
    Resolver->>Templates: Fetch skill template
    Templates-->>Resolver: Template dict (primitive_sequence)
    Note over Resolver: Resolves initial gripper states,<br/>named poses, and relative motions
    Resolver->>Primitive: Instantiate PrimitiveSpec(primitive_name, ...)
    Primitive-->>Resolver: Return list[PrimitiveSpec]
    Resolver-->>Agent: Concrete primitives sequence
    
    Note over Resolver: Sources - src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py

来源：src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py

resolver.py 中的关键函数

  • direction_to_delta(direction, distance, direction_mapping)：将分类方向（forward、backward、left、right、up、down）转换为笛卡尔坐标偏移 (dx, dy, dz) src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py:30-48。

  • _resolve_pose_name(...)：解析显式位姿名称、放置请求名称或命名目标字典 src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py:51-77。

  • resolve_skill_primitives(...)：校验模板激活，处理 initial_gripper_state（open、closed、hold、none），并遍历 primitive_sequence 构建 PrimitiveSpec 对象列表 src/skill_library/skill_library/resolver.py:99-172。

4. 技能模板与轨迹展开

技能模板将静态步骤定义与动态轨迹展开组合，用于复杂社交手势与运动例程（如 wave_hello、nod_yes、shake_no、celebrate 与 dance_basic）src/embodied_common/test/test_social_gestures.py。

轨迹展开流程

        graph LR
    A["Raw Skill Template"] --> B["Trajectory Template Step"]
    B --> C["expand_trajectory_template()"]
    C --> D["Waypoint Generation (move_to_joint_positions)"]
    D --> E["Runtime-Ready Primitive Sequence"]

    subgraph "Sources"
    C -.-> S1["src/embodied_common/test/test_social_gestures.py"]
    end

来源：src/embodied_common/test/test_social_gestures.py

模板确保安全检查，例如验证绝对关节轨迹具有安全进入点与正确的时长估计 src/embodied_common/test/test_social_gestures.py:122-163。
